thread:
anna.dev: Quick check — cutover plan for v2 endpoints tomorrow. We still need clear owners for traffic slicing, SDK timer migration, and the deprecation notice cadence. Who's owning traffic % toggles? :eyes:
ricardo: I can take traffic slicing for hosted + dedicated. I'll coordinate the gating policy. Timeline: start canary 09:00 UTC, 25% for 2h, 50% for 2h, then 100% if no regressions.
priya-m: I'll own runtime-side SDK timer migration (KV cache timers and max-latency safeguards). Need to land the shim that preserves old timeout semantics first. ETA today EOD for the shim PR.
mike.r: I'll handle release messaging and the public deprecation blog + changelog. Need final SDK version and the sunset date to publish. What's the exact SDK bump token?
devex-bot: @mike.r SDK releases are on the checklist: update CHANGELOG.md, publish packages, and push docs PR. Link: https://git.redwood.dev/devex/release-checklist
ricardo: For toggles, plan is to use control-plane flag "v2_traffic_slice" and per-customer override. Config example: ```json
{ "v2_traffic_slice": { "default": 0.25, "canary_customers": ["custA","custB"] } }
```
anna.dev: Nice. priya, does the shim require a DB migration or just a config flip?
priya-m: No DB migration. It's a runtime compatibility layer that rewrites KV keys for the old client TTLs. We'll enable behind flag `compat_ttl_shim`. I'll add opt-in telemetry for 24h.
john-oncall: Heads up: oncall runbook update needed for 502s during canary. Add the quick rollback toggle (`v2_fallback_to_v1`) and the diagnostic curl to validate endpoints. I'll add snippets.
ops-bot: Runbook draft uploaded: https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/v2-cutover. Added rollback snippet and Pager rota note.
anna.dev: SDK timelines: devex, can you confirm which SDKs get a forced minor bump vs patch?
devex-bot: Prioritization: python -> minor (breaking param rename), js -> patch (shim compatibility), go -> minor (deps). I'll open the release PRs after we freeze.
mike.r: For the deprecation notice: propose 60 days from full cutover for the v1 sunset. If cutover completes tomorrow (UTC), we set sunset = 60 days later and put notice in SDK changelogs + dashboard banner. Any objections?
ricardo: 60 days sounds fine. Add an automatic fallback for enterprise customers with compliance concerns — flag `enterprise_allowlist`.
priya-m: Quick ask: if we see KV latency > 50ms during 25% canary, we should pause. Can we add a Circuit Breaker metric in the rollout job?
\ohn: (typo) sorry
john-oncall: Confirmed — I'll add an alert: `kv.latency.p95 > 50ms` during canary => pause and notify #eng-oncall.
anna.dev: Action items summary: ricardo -> traffic slicing policy + toggle PR; priya -> compat shim + telemetry + circuit-breaker; mike -> messaging + sunset date; devex -> SDK bump PRs & docs; john -> runbook + alerts. We'll reconvene in async check at 17:00 UTC for final go/no-go.
ricardo: I'll post the toggle PR and include rollout timings. ETA 07:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
priya-m: Shim PR is WIP, will request review by 05:30 UTC.
mike.r: Draft blog + banner copy incoming by 08:00 UTC.
devex-bot: Noted. I'll queue the SDK release PRs after cutover completes.
anna.dev: Thanks all — please ping this thread if anything blocks.
ricardo: pinged @eng-sre for infra quota check, cc @sales for enterprise allowlist touches.
priya-m: One last thing — add a small example for SDK usage in the deprecation note: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2', timeout: 120000 });
```
anna.dev: Perfect. Closing for now, see updates in the thread.
